breakdown.description: Vapor pressure head is inconsistent with the stated temperature (Hv=0.3 m does not correspond to water at 100 C).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification directly repeats the original error, stating 'Use vapor pressure head Hv = 0.3 m' for water at 100°C. It does not correct Hv to ~10.3 m (the actual vapor pressure head at 100°C) nor does it adjust the temperature to ~25°C where Hv ≈ 0.3 m would be appropriate. The inconsistency is entirely unresolved.
